282ddccb781a.text: Chronal integration interrupted. Subject: Vale, Ethan. Synchronisation sixty-one percent.

495da6069417.text: Containment breach, sublevels four through nine. All personnel evacuate.

4a4008481c26.text: Volunteer seven. Mister Vale. You understand nobody can promise you come back the same man.

4498e508e78a.text: I understand. Someone has to go first.

bd5f8cb4a233.text: That was me. I signed up for this?

6b6689725f61.text: All units, sublevel six. Volunteer seven is loose. Containment is your only priority.

f3b12a887fab.text: Contact! Down on the floor, now!

ddfce917e219.text: Warning. Localised temporal discontinuity in lab 04.

1c4fd3ecb8b1.text: That door is cycling faster than anyone could move. Unless...

411aed52aef4.text: Sentinel A-07 authorised. Neutralise the anomaly.

73bfc5215bc5.text: Freight lift two. Ascending to surface level.

e586533decc2.text: Volunteer seven has surfaced. Sector nine. Nobody engages without me.

04643e0a0505.text: Okay. Let's see how far this goes.

09aac137babd.text: The ceiling came down... and stopped. It's just hanging there.

868f657f1b60.text: He's heading for the Engine. Seal the core and put him down.

9cb490d081ae.text: Up. Whatever's up there can't be worse than this.

06576724707a.text: That's not one city. That's all of them.

4253aaac2be2.text: All teams. The anomaly came up on the north stack. He's on the roofs. Box him in.

e6ca6e82c152.text: Down. I need to get down.

f0e2aec1a2d7.text: It's morning on my street and night on the next one. My daughter's school isn't there any more. There's a field. Just a field.

50ee21f239b3.text: If anyone finds this... we went north. Toward the tower. Everyone says it's the only thing that's still the same.

0e1451b0df6a.text: It's not falling. It's just... stopped.

43f68ad5a1f9.text: Don't touch it. Whatever stopped it is still in there.

f819ed54fe10.text: Who is this? How are you on this channel?

6e2be648b5cb.text: Your gauntlet is talking to my rig. That makes you Volunteer Seven. The cafe on the east side, under the green awning. Move.

20793735fc5e.text: Close the door. They track movement, not people.

e9ed861f2bdd.text: I know what you are. I helped build the thing on your arm.

9b5a1e54e042.text: Then tell me what happened down there.

98927db5d9be.text: The Engine was supposed to look. Just look, along the timeline. Instead it pulled. Every version of this city is trying to be it at once.

219cff878821.text: And you are the only thing in it that can push back. Your integration keeps a few seconds of your own past. You can step back into them.

937d7cd108a3.text: Four seconds. Use them well, because HELIX will not give you five.

12e4ea6b5baa.text: HELIX sweep. If the light touches you, the shutter drops and the whole block knows. If it does... you know what to do.

b5aafa877c2e.text: That was close. Again, and they would have had you.

c71cc3864ecb.text: Clean. You are better at this than you think.

2915d44aa084.text: There he is. Plaza units, he is yours.

1c730c72126f.text: More coming from the south gate. Stay off the open ground.

f09e6f3c33e1.text: Heavy unit, plaza. Bring it in!

96f0dd6f50df.text: That's all of these. Something else is coming, Ethan. Something HELIX only sends when it means it.

5544bf9893e0.text: Marshal, you have the anomaly. Bring him in. Whole, if you can.

7eca8f0c5fe3.text: Run. Don't fight it here. Get to the roofs!

736728eeffa6.text: HELIX temporal enforcement. It is wearing the same thing you are, just more of it. Break its rhythm, Ethan.

22b698d1f9ef.text: Its recorder survived. HELIX logs everything. Let me see what it knows about you.

968adfab5683.text: Timestamp says four twelve. The Engine went critical at four fifteen.

fe09d4a82e88.text: I walked into it. Before it happened. I walked in.

35a53cb65a4a.text: Then you were not caught in the disaster, Ethan. You were in it on purpose.

3aabcd2ab134.text: The HELIX arcology. Palimpsest was run from here. If there is a record of what they did to you, it is in this building.

9cca1e8e86f7.text: In this year they are. The building exists twice now, Ethan, and your integration can stand in either. Feel for the seam.

c02227984b4a.text: The floor is only gone in one of them. Pick the other before you step.

027be62f3c54.text: Twenty years... maybe more. Nobody has been here in a long time.

5e62169dc0d5.text: Glass in one year, rubble in the other. Neither of them lets you walk straight through. Both of them together might.

7c0fc7abc89a.text: You are slower than I remember.

4f656b9942ca.text: Ethan, I am reading two of you. Two signatures, the same one. Ethan... get out of there.

e1949c1f7593.text: Project Palimpsest. Objective: identify divergent timelines and overwrite them with the preferred history. Authorisation: Director Voss.

17f7f829944d.text: Every catastrophe we have ever suffered was a branch someone failed to prune. The Engine lets us prune. Begin with the timelines where HELIX loses.

55300e15d7b5.text: Prune. He means erase. Whole futures, and everyone living in them.

c471b5b3a718.text: That pedestal is drawing power in both timelines at once. Whatever it records, it records across them.

643dd1c47295.text: I can feel it. A few seconds behind me, still moving.

41adff592696.text: An echo. It does what you just did, exactly, a few seconds late. Stand where it needs to stand, then let it take your place.

46d42e49d139.text: Ethan, your reading just doubled again.

76bd28e835e5.text: You keep looking for the man who broke the world. You keep finding mirrors.

8956145fe7ba.text: Ask the Engine. It made both of us.

a99c4913d678.text: Contact! Two of them, same signature!

abb083339aa6.text: They built this to choose which of us gets to exist.

592b3ec4a933.text: I tried. Look around you. This is what trying looks like.

2a1d72d0364c.text: The whole room just slipped into the other timeline. It is his ground now. Make it yours.

5b80ca67d1a4.text: Palimpsest was never a cure. Voss meant to overwrite every future where HELIX did not win.

0548154345cc.text: I broke it. I went into the Engine to tear it apart, and so did you. Two of us in the same moment. That is what fractured everything.

4c03a9f210e5.text: It was us. Both of us. Neither of us gets to call it an accident.

f8f4d830d05b.text: Ethan, I have a second Engine signature. Voss is bringing another one online. The fractures are spreading faster.

face79b6baa7.text: Then he is finishing what he started. Go. I will find you when it matters.

b121530db9f9.text: You are standing in the future, Ethan. Twenty one oh one, if the clocks here can be trusted.

dcbc8eb8c560.text: And the storm I can hear behind it?

9c3d257ffdaf.text: The same terrace after Voss wins. Both are real now, and they are leaking into each other.

4457c92d7527.text: The bridge only exists in one of them. Do not change your mind halfway across.

73406f43a53d.text: Unregistered chronal signature on the terrace! Engage!

60d26023bb12.text: You should. HELIX, ten years before the Incident. Ethan... touch the shards. Please.

6b98ff760f11.text: Four fifteen, the fourteenth of March, twenty eighty nine. A chronal cascade takes the city. Every model agrees.

66a2594296a9.text: Every model we built, Soren. That is not the same thing.

6f63f820828d.text: If the prediction holds, someone has to be inside the Engine when it starts. I will do it.

370de10a119c.text: The integration has never been tested on a person.

2c42d6c27242.text: The cascade data was edited. Someone wrote the disaster into the model.

7e642eb95f69.text: Then you understand why you cannot remember this. Doctor Reyes. His memory. Tonight.

41eed623b66a.text: I took it from you. Voss ordered it and I did it. I hid what I took inside the Engine's own memory, so you could find it if you lived.

c98cb9c90795.text: Why should I trust you now?

4c2d1e27fed5.text: You should not. But you need me for what comes next.

b7842cab58ad.text: A HELIX foundry, coming apart between two timelines. In one it is still pouring. In the other it went cold years ago.

8d8395db91eb.text: Not in this timeline. In the other one that metal set years ago.

bba393d65ad9.text: Dead. Nothing has run in here for years.

fc6c1c8e96f1.text: Door is open. Something is waiting past it. One signature, very steady.

b776aa0a4874.text: Ethan Vale. You were the best of us. You still could be.

39fc1c0d7387.text: Walk back through that door and I will tell Voss I never found you.

e5fe38334f82.text: He erased me once. I am not walking anywhere for him.

cda57063721e.text: Then let us see how much of you he left.

3c29a11fe09f.text: You are not the only one he gave time to.

3f6c33548299.text: This place is failing. So are you.

adeb461a474b.text: The platform is losing its timeline. Watch the ground, Ethan, it is going to flip under you.

0f5cc508530f.text: I read the cascade data too, Ethan. The same night you did. He did not erase me. He promoted me.

3ac75d94b32c.text: The Engines are a network now. To restore anything you would have to go inside it. Into the Nexus.

5e2fd9e9484f.text: If you restore the original timeline, every branch that grew from the fracture could be erased. People who only exist now.

75d933d36a9e.text: Then I will find another way.

e104ab663f1a.text: I said I would. When it matters.

bfcfd8d2a1fb.text: You are inside the Nexus. Everything the fractures tore loose ends up here, turning around the Engine.

85601b47b09b.text: It is a wound, Ethan. Every one of those islands was somewhere. Somebody lived there.

a5c750c305c3.text: Elites on the island. He is through the gate!

7c0522b32cbd.text: You were going to do the last part alone.

2064eebf37ab.text: We tried that once. Both of us, separately. Look where it got everyone.

9d485e09db01.text: Left side. I have the right.

6cabb8b4135c.text: Go. Voss will be waiting at the heart. I will keep the way open behind you.

e99cd34d8a73.text: Ethan. You walked into the Engine to save a city. I only ever asked for the same thing on a larger scale.

09989031b782.text: You wrote the disaster into the model.

10ecba194321.text: I wrote the future we were going to have anyway, and made sure HELIX was standing at the end of it. Somebody has to choose.

848875ccbaea.text: You think in one timeline at a time. That is why you lose.

3fe368f159a1.text: He is drawing on the Engine directly. Watch the pylons, and do not stand in his fields.

7f2e15f5fde4.text: Then let none of it hold. If HELIX cannot have this future, nobody will.

5c6f2becb294.text: Ethan! The platform is coming apart between timelines. Everything you have, now.

a8996697cc42.text: Whatever you do with it, you will be doing what I did. Choosing for everyone.

6b23cfaf1e68.text: Ethan, listen to me. If you restore the original timeline, everything since the fracture goes. Including what I did, and what I tried to undo.

969c43c2999a.text: And if you keep them, you keep what Voss broke as well. There is no clean answer here.

a7a0da7f0d0d.text: Then this is goodbye. I was only ever here because the world broke.

c887cfa62854.text: You are awake early. The integration test is not until six.

4f2bb671f5c6.text: Imani. The Engine. Do not start it. Not tonight.

f93a81410eac.text: I am sorry, have we met? You know my name.

7eba71c8459d.text: Let them stand. All of them. Seal each one where it is.

add7ba88e142.text: The fractures are closing around each world, not across them. They are holding, Ethan. They are holding.

36f33bf7ccc7.text: Somewhere out there the terrace is still white, and the foundry is still pouring. And here it is just raining.

97abf0f1b258.text: My timeline is still out there too. I think I will go and see what is left of it.

04a49347b9a8.text: You see me every time you look in a mirror. Try to make me look better.
